questions.text: Which of the following protocol is used for transferring electronic mail messages from one machine to another?
questions.solution:
SMTP (Simple Mail Transfer Protocol) transfers e-mail between machines (mail servers).

Answer: SMTP

questions.text: When a DNS server accepts and uses incorrect information from a host that has no authority giving that information, then it is called
questions.solution:
Accepting forged answers from a source with no authority and storing them (cache poisoning) is DNS spoofing.

Answer: DNS spoofing

questions.text: Identify the correct sequence in which the following packets are transmitted on the network by a host when a browser requests a webpage from a remote server,assuming that the host has just been restarted.
questions.solution:
After a restart, nothing is cached:
1. DNS query to get the server's IP
2. TCP SYN to open the connection
3. HTTP GET on that connection

Answer: DNS query, TCP SYN, HTTP GET request

DNS query, HTTP GET request, TCP SYN

TCP SYN, DNS query, HTTP GET request

questions.text:
Which of the following is/are example(s) of stateful application layer protocols?
(i) HTTP
(ii) FTP
(iii) TCP
(iv) POP3
questions.solution:
Checking each statement:
- HTTP is stateless (each request is independent).
- FTP keeps session state (login, current directory) [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] stateful.
- TCP is a transport protocol, not application layer.
- POP3 keeps session state (authorization, transaction states) [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] stateful.

Answer: (ii) and (iv) only

Click here for detail solution by gateoverflow

PING itself uses ICMP. When an error happens (host unreachable, TTL exceeded), an ICMP error message is returned. So statement 3 is false.

Answer: If PING encounters an error condition, an ICMP message is not returned

Click here for detail solution by gateoverflow
options: PING is a TCP/IP application that sends datagrams once every second in the hope of an echo response from the machine being PINGED
If the machine is connected and running a TCP/IP protocol stack, it should respond to the PING datagram with a datagram of its own
If PING encounters an error condition, an ICMP message is not returned
PING display the time of the return response in milliseconds or one of several error message
